name: 12 GB consumer GPU (RTX 3060 12 GB class)
notes: A class entry for 12 GB cards. The reference card is the RTX 3060 12 GB, the most common GPU in Steam's hardware survey per the builders who report on it.
Bandwidth is derived from the card's published memory configuration: 15 Gbps GDDR6 on a 192-bit bus = 360 GB/s.
27B-class models only fit here as 2-bit or ternary builds (Bonsai 2, Saluki, GSQ-RCO IQ2/IQ3). A standard Q4 27B (about 17-18 GB) does not fit without CPU offload.
Ampere tensor cores: no native FP8/FP4 path.

memory.note: dedicated VRAM; host RAM is separate and matters only for offload lanes. 360 GB/s derived from 15 Gbps x 192-bit / 8.

sources.note: RTX 3060: 3584 cores, 1777 MHz boost, 15 Gbps, 12 GB GDDR6 192-bit
